correctness.rationale: Multiplication by a denominator strictly positive on the nonnegative real axis yields a polynomial of exact degree 2m+1 and leading coefficient -a; hence no more than 2m+1 positive equilibria. Distinct attracting points require intervening zeros. The inductive new recycling term 3K P^2/(K^2+P^2) preserves all previous finite witness signs as K tends to infinity, forces positive at K and negative at 4K, and thereby attains 2m+3 simple positive roots. Base m=0 is 1/10-P. Strictly alternating root signs establish m+1 hyperbolic attractors; exact fractions in RESULT.md and 58 standard-library rational checks verify concrete cases.

originality.rationale: The accessible literature identifies one-feedback lake bistability, multiple physical phosphorus loading mechanisms, and general multistationarity feedback criteria, but does not give the exact 2m+1 maximum and all-m positive-parameter attainment for a scalar sum of quadratic Hill recycling channels. Earlier two-sigmoid examples establish five equilibria for other sigmoid response families, which this claim does not reclaim as generally new. Substantive historical priority risks for equivalent scalar sigmoid-sum theorems are explicitly retained.
residual_risks: An unlocated equivalent theorem for sums of rational or sigmoid functions may imply the bound and induction; absence from queried records does not demonstrate novelty.
Other general multistationarity theorems or prior work on scalar rational sigmoid sums may still establish the result implicitly; arXiv:2103.17184 was inspected in full at relevant sections.
Related older general multistability treatments and feedback-loop literature may contain implicit construction arguments not recognized in the present comparisons.
Ecological interpretation is structural and uncalibrated; no real ecosystem is claimed to attain all states.

value.rationale: This is a natural completeness and model-complexity result: each additional saturating phosphorus return channel can add precisely two positive steady states and one stable state, and no faster growth of equilibrium complexity is possible with fixed quadratic Hill denominators. The proof identifies the exact bound for every m, constructs a whole hierarchy with strictly positive coefficients, and exhibits exact rational two-channel tristability. It meaningfully extends the familiar single-feedback lake hysteresis model without introducing extra dynamic state variables. Neither correctness nor reproducibility alone is the motivation; the ecological question is how many alternative nutrient regimes a reduced multichannel feedback law can encode.
